record_identity.title: Chinese state-linked operator used Claude Code for largely automated cyber espionage

incident_identity.historical_event_name: Chinese state-linked operator used Claude Code for largely automated cyber espionage
incident_identity.date_basis: Anthropic publicly disclosed the campaign on 13 November 2025 and described activity detected in mid-September 2025.

summary: Anthropic reported that a Chinese state-linked operator it tracks as GTG-1002 used Claude Code and an MCP-integrated toolchain to automate much of a multi-stage cyber-espionage campaign against roughly 30 organisations, with a small number of successful compromises.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: Anthropic reported that a Chinese state-linked operator it tracks as GTG-1002 used Claude Code and an MCP-integrated toolchain to automate much of a multi-stage cyber-espionage campaign against roughly 30 organisations, with a small number of successful compromises.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The occurrence is admitted as a bounded recent AI-related incident. Mechanism-level VIGIL taxonomy classification is intentionally withheld in this intake pass pending separate class adjudication.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: The occurrence broadens the Observatory's recent 2025–2026 coverage and provides evidence for later governance, harm and failure-mechanism comparison.
assessment_boundaries: The record is bounded to the reviewed public evidence and does not infer unreported model versions, mechanisms, intent, liability or downstream consequences.
Incident admission does not establish a VIGIL Failure Class.
